notes: Excluded as above_phy. The learning acts on UAV trajectory and task offloading, not on a physical-layer decision. p. 6: "optimizing task offloading decisions (O) and UAV trajectory planning, which is decomposed into velocity (v) and direction (θ)". p. 9: offloading is replaced by a greedy rule, "directing communication exclusively to the nearest terminal with offloadable tasks", and "The action space is thus restructured as follows: at = {v t, θt}". No transmit power, resource or beam control is learned: UAV transmit power 40 W and power splitting ratio 0.8 are fixed parameters (p. 13, Table I), and the directional antenna gain follows from the UAV position (p. 5, Eq. 3).
